section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section summarizes the findings of the current study, which investigated body appreciation, media influence, and respondent weight status as predictors of cosmetic surgery consideration among female undergraduates. It highlights body appreciation as the strongest predictor and discusses the unexpected direction of BMI's prediction and the non-significance of age as a predictor. The section also notes limitations related to the select undergraduate sample and suggests future research directions.
